notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.10 - Script: a Write with a list of values (for example float values 1.5, -2) now runs; before, Run rejected it as a malformed step. During a run, a finished case shows its result right away instead of "not visited" until the loop ended. A text Ask answer can now be shown in Log, Pause and Ask messages as ${name}; the check before Run no longer refuses it. Device list: the status badge stays visible on devices with many Slave IDs; IDs that do not fit show as +N, and hovering a device lists them all.
